title: Code Story story file
description: A Code Story story file, schema version 1. The plugin saves stories as .codestory/local/<yyyy-MM-dd>-<slug>.story.json at the Git repository root (the project folder when there is no Git). Files are UTF-8, pretty-printed, with the fields in the order of this schema, and at most 256 KB.

id.description: The file name without .story.json. A number suffix keeps IDs unique.

title.description: The story title: 8 words or fewer.

steps.description: The steps in reading order: 3 to 12 are best, 15 at most.

title.description: The step title: 8 words or fewer.

comment.description: What the code does and why it matters: 1 to 3 short sentences in simple English.

location.description: A range of lines in one file.

file.description: The file path relative to the story root (the Git repository root), with / between folders. No absolute paths and no '..' segments.

startLine.description: The first line of the range, 1-based.

endLine.description: The last line of the range, 1-based and inclusive. Not smaller than startLine.
